product.name: The Ultimate Margaret River Adventure
product.shortDescription: Experience the best of the Margaret River region on an immersive three or four day journey of adventure and indulgence. The most active way to experience all corners of the Margaret River region.
product.description:
Your Ultimate Margaret River Experience

Discover the very best of the Margaret River region on an immersive, fully guided 3 or 4 day escape designed for those who want more than just a holiday. This is where coastal adventure meets world-class food and wine.

Walk spectacular sections of the iconic Cape to Cape track, kayak along the Margaret River, cycle through forest and vineyard trails, and uncover natural wonders like Jewel Cave. Stand at the meeting point of two oceans at the historic Cape Leeuwin Lighthouse and indulge in unforgettable paddock-to-plate dining and premium wine experiences. All thoughtfully curated into one seamless journey.

CLICK HERE to read our full itinerary 


What You Can Expect

This experience has been designed to showcase the true diversity of Margaret River, from rugged coastline and ancient caves to boutique wineries and artisan producers. 

Each day blends:

  • Guided coastal hiking and nature immersion
  • Unique adventure experiences including kayaking and cycling
  • Iconic landmarks and hidden local gems
  • Exceptional food and wine experiences
All delivered by passionate local guides who live and breathe this region.

Expect connection, discovery and unforgettable moments, without the stress of planning


Everything Taken Care Of

From the moment you arrive, every detail of your tour is handled.

No logistics. No planning. No hire care required.

Just arrive and experience Margaret River the way it was meant to be experience.

** Please note accommodation, breakfast and dinner are not included in the package, however can be included for an additional cost.


Your Experience Includes

Seamless Travel & Transfers

  • Return transfers from Busselton Airport (Perth Airport Transfers available for an additional cost)
  • All transport throughout your journey
  • Accommodation pick-up and drop-off
  • Fully coordinated daily itinerary

Signature Experiences

  • Guided walking on the Cape to Cape Track
  • Entry and guided tour of Jewel Cave
  • Visit to Cape Leeuwin Lighthouse
  • Kayaking or cycling adventure options 
Expert Local Guides

  • Passionate, knowledgeable guides throughout
  • Deep insights into the region’s landscapes, history and culture
  • A personalised small-group experience
Fully Supported Experience

  • All activities and entry fees included
  • Equipment provided (kayaks, bikes, safety gear)
  • On-tour support and safety management
  • Carefully designed daily pacing
Premium Food & Wine

  • Paddock-to-plate dining experience
  • Curated winery tastings
  • Gourmet morning tea, lunch and picnic experiences

Why Book This Experience

Effortless, premium travel

Forget navigating maps, booking venues or driving between locations. Every detail is taken care of so you can simply relax and enjoy.

Experience More in Less Time

The Margaret River region is vast and diverse. This curated itinerary allows you to experience the very best of the region in just a few days, without missing the highlights.

A Perfect Balance of Adventure & Indulgence

This is not just a tour, it's a carefully crafted journey combining:

  • Active outdoor experiences
  • Iconic natural attractions
  • World-class food and wine 

Why Choose Cape to Cape Explorer Tours

At Cape to Cape Explorer Tours we pride ourselves on creating the highest quality Margaret River experiences available. 

An award-winning, local company, we support the natural environment of the region and the economy of our local community. Our guides and staff all live in the area, are professionally trained and have an intimate knowledge of the Margaret River region.

We deliver personalised and quality service – a fun, healthy holiday with great food, company, scenery and a wonderful sense of accomplishment! Your safety and satisfaction is our priority and our attention to detail and love of looking after all the ‘little things’ has led to many repeat customers and glowing reviews. We look forward to welcoming you to Margaret River and sharing the natural wonders of the region – especially the Cape to Cape Track with you!


Carbon Offset

For every participant on a multi-day tour, we donate $5 toward planting a native tree to help offset the carbon from your time exploring the Margaret
River region. We partner directly with Nature Conservation Margaret River Region, with all offset funds directly funding native plants — while our staff proudly join local volunteer planting days to help grow them. You can also choose to fund planting EXTRA trees should you wish: $5 for one more tree, $25 for 5 more trees, or $100 for 20 more trees

extras.name: Breakfast Hamper
extras.description: Enjoy a supply hamper with a great variety of items for fresh and tasty daily breakfasts and yummy local treats to indulge in. Items depend on availability and seasonality, but include our in-house muesli blend and chia pudding; eggs and breakfast items such as mushrooms, spinach and cherry tomatoes; yoghurt, fresh fruit and wood-fired bread; tea and freshly roasted coffee and local artisan products.

extras.name: Dinner & Dessert
extras.description: Don't fancy heading out for your evening meal, enjoy our delicious in-house catered dinner and dessert option

extras.name: Fishing Experience - Adult
extras.description:
Join our professional & experienced guides for a land-based fishing adventure at the best local spot (depending on conditions and what’s biting).

Includes time to explore the coastline, catch local edible fish, transfers to + from your accommodation in the region, bait & tackle, local beverages & nibbles.

Duration: Approx. 4 hours from 4pm-8pm  (including travel time). 

Minimum 2 guests

extras.name: Cape to Cape Explorer Tours T-shirts
extras.description:
New Cape to Cape Explorer Tours men's and women's Tees!


Grab your high-quality, locally-printed AS Colour T-shirt in black with our Cape to Cape Explorer Tours logo printed on the front above the words “Cape to Cape Track, Margaret River, Western Australia”.


The women's Martina tee is a relaxed fit design which looks great on all shapes and sizes. It's off the shoulder seams allow for casual drape and premium feel.  Sizes available: xsmall, small, medium, large, xlarge 

For men, the Organic Staple Tee is a well designed, regular fit favourite with timeless style and comfort. Sizes available: medium, large, xlarge 

Select SIZE at the checkout page, thank you.

You will receive your shirt from your Cape to Cape Explorer Tours driver on the first day of your hiking adventure!

Note: models wearing sizes in group photo from left to right: M-large, W-medium, W-large, M-large, W-Large, W-medium, W-small

extras.name: Upgrade to E-Bike Adventure
extras.description: Take a load off while you pedal around the scenic trails for the region by choosing and E-Bike adventure.

extras.name: Add an additional 4th day to your experience
extras.description:
Want to add and extra 4th day to your Margaret River Experience?

Wild coast, wild life & local flavours
Experience a day that captures the natural beauty and unique character of Margaret River. Choose between a peaceful guided paddle along the river or a scenic coastal hike, both offering immersive encounters with the region’s landscapes. Enjoy a relaxed lunch showcasing local produce before an unforgettable visit to the Capes Raptor Centre, where you’ll witness majestic birds of prey up close. Blending nature, wildlife, and regional flavours, this experience offers a rich and memorable finale to your journey.
